scope: Worker operations: default safe failure logs, typed middleware assembly, failed-job inspection and idempotent operator retries, lease-loss admission and shutdown failure reporting

verification_environment.native: macOS arm64; go1.27.1 selected natively by the existing project setup
verification_environment.cache: Existing warm Go caches; no competing full gates
verification_environment.tools: Existing real gopls, native Node and project TypeScript compiler selected through the existing test variables
verification_environment.data: Existing private test configuration and isolated test data; no reset/drop/flush or new database servers

source_integrity.manifest_encoding: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, separators comma/colon, no trailing newline

failures_and_corrections.finding: The first generator invocation lacked access to the native Go cache under the sandbox.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Reused the same native warm cache through an approved escalation; generation and final generated-output checks passed.

failures_and_corrections.finding: Redis must encode expected_attempts=0 when retrying a failure that occurred before its first attempt started.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Removed omitempty from the expected-attempt comparison field; added the zero-started-attempt case to the shared memory/real-Redis contract.

failures_and_corrections.finding: Lease loss could leave another reservation loop admitting work while a cancelled handler ignored its context.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Heartbeat now stops the worker immediately on lost ownership or renewal error while retaining the affected handler until exit.
failures_and_corrections.recheck: Both scenarios pass the final runtime race suite and full gate.

failures_and_corrections.finding: An exhausted attempt budget during worker shutdown needed terminal failure logging and failed observation classification.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Classify and log exhausted shutdown as failed; keep ordinary shutdown releases quiet. Both cases have explicit regression assertions.
failures_and_corrections.recheck: Final runtime/consumer races and full make verify passed.

failures_and_corrections.disposition: Intentionally stopped the task-owned process group before completion to apply the final shutdown correction; superseded by verify-completed, not accepted as a full gate.

failures_and_corrections.finding: An optional resource-measurement wrapper for the final documentation check could not run /bin/ps inside the sandbox and stopped that child process before checking docs.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Ran make docs-check and git diff --check directly; both passed without additional permissions.

earlier_full_gate.disposition: Passed before the final audit corrections; retained for history, superseded by verify-completed.

review: Configured modules borrow the runtime logger. FailureLog defaults to true and generated typed settings expose the override; standalone workers require an explicitly injected logger.

Logs contain safe primitive metadata only. Tests cover retry/terminal levels, unconfirmed finalization, disabled logging, raw error/payload exclusion, panic, Goexit and a blocked sink retaining capacity and shutdown ownership.

Memory and real Redis share retry contract tests: 16 concurrent submissions apply once, exact envelope and identity survive, attempts restart in a new bounded cycle, stale leases fail, outbox enqueue dedup survives and repeated tokens cannot reopen a later failure.
Retry tests cover expiry, workflow rejection, zero-started-attempt terminal failure and the manual cycle limit. Ambiguous backend responses reconcile using the same saved token.

CLI parsing happens before service startup; commands reuse named connections, expose bounded safe metadata and require an explicit saved retry token. Output failure after mutation remains reconcilable.
The independent consumer exercises configured logging, application.JobWith, typed failure hooks, CLI declaration, selected-connection retry and isolation from another named connection.
Compiler rejection fixtures preserve payload-specific retry IDs and middleware owners. Real gopls completion, hover and definition probes cover typed retry and configured middleware.

Existing Backend remains source compatible through optional RetryBackend. Envelope wire format and queue configuration identity are unchanged; optional persisted retry metadata requires coordinated worker/tool rollout before manual retries.

Retry eligibility and token generation have one shared owner; configured Job delegates to JobWith, and operation commands reuse the existing CLI lifecycle. No new dependencies or mutable application-global services were added.

The final full gate includes vet, package and independent consumer tests, generated-output checks, documentation checks and release-helper tests. The phase=failure exit=7 line in stdout is an intentional passing Python runner test; the unittest suite and make both exit successfully.
limits: At-least-once delivery remains the contract. Stable job IDs help application side-effect idempotency; manual retry cannot prove an earlier effect failed.
Workflow-member replay is rejected. Whole-workflow recovery requires an explicit application decision.
No dashboard, autoscaling or automatic process restart is added. Redis persistence/failover and process supervision remain deployment responsibilities.
Context cancellation cannot terminate an uncooperative handler or logger. Resource ownership remains until actual callback exit.
Default logs intentionally omit arbitrary returned errors; applications may select safe domain diagnostics in typed Failed middleware.
Boilerplate integration and deployed multi-process acceptance remain application work. No framework revision was committed, pushed, tagged or published, and no boilerplate dependency was changed.

documentation_checks.result: Documentation links, blueprint numbering, and fixture Go requirements are valid.
